title: "Two incompatible sacred values in American universities" Jon Haidt, Hayek Lecture Series
channel: Duke University Department of Political Science
summary: Jonathan Haidt's Hayek Lecture at Duke argues American universities pursue two potentially incompatible sacred values, truth and social justice. He discusses campus conflict, honor, dignity and victimhood cultures, and viewpoint diversity.
why: HN cites it heavily in diversity and academia debates as an intellectual analysis of the truth versus social justice conflict.

quote.text: This is the best intellectual analysis of the situation I've come across so far
